claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: AM-251 is a selective CB1 cannabinoid receptor antagonist with no intrinsic cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak killing attributable to nonspecific lipophilic/cationic amphiphilic effects rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
